sql:
with o as (
  select lo.id, lo.kalshi_order_id, lo.market_ticker, lo.created_at, lo.limit_price,
         split_part(lo.market_ticker,'-',1) as series,
         c.market_type, c.market_mode, c.regime, c.hours_to_close, c.spread, c.market_volume
  from live_orders lo left join execution_order_context c on c.live_order_id = lo.id
  where lo.strategy = 'Fmmsell10' and lo.created_at >= '2026-09-07T02:03:36Z' and lo.created_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' and lo.kalshi_order_id is not null
), f as (
  select kalshi_order_id, min(coalesce((raw_fill_json->>'created_time')::timestamptz, filled_at)) ft
  from fills group by 1
), t as (
  select market_ticker, avg(pnl * 100.0 / nullif(quantity, 0)) c
  from paper_trades where strategy = 'Fmmsell10_pt4' and pnl is not null group by 1
), qa as (
  select distinct on (live_order_id) live_order_id, contracts_ahead
  from live_order_queue_ticks where contracts_ahead is not null and strategy = 'Fmmsell10'
  order by live_order_id, captured_at
), x as (
  select o.*, (f.ft is not null) filled, extract(epoch from f.ft - o.created_at) / 60.0 fmin, t.c, qa.contracts_ahead qa
  from o left join f using (kalshi_order_id) left join t using (market_ticker)
         left join qa on qa.live_order_id = o.id
  where t.c is not null
), y as (
  select x.*, d.dim, d.bucket from x cross join lateral (values
    ('all', 'all'),
    ('type', coalesce(market_type, '?')),
    ('mode', coalesce(market_mode, '?')),
    ('regime', coalesce(regime, '?')),
    ('series', series),
    ('nopx', limit_price::text),
    ('fillmin', case when not filled then 'unfilled' when fmin < 1 then 'a <1m' when fmin < 10 then 'b 1-10m'
                     when fmin < 60 then 'c 10-60m' else 'd 60m+' end),
    ('queue', case when qa is null then 'none' when qa < 50 then 'a <50' when qa < 500 then 'b 50-499'
                   when qa < 2000 then 'c 500-1999' else 'd 2000+' end),
    ('spread', coalesce(spread::text, '?')),
    ('htc', case when hours_to_close is null then '?' when hours_to_close < 3 then 'a <3h' when hours_to_close < 12 then 'b 3-12h'
                 when hours_to_close < 48 then 'c 12-48h' else 'd 48h+' end),
    ('vol', case when market_volume is null then '?' when market_volume < 2000 then 'a <2k' when market_volume < 20000 then 'b 2-20k'
                 when market_volume < 200000 then 'c 20-200k' else 'd 200k+' end),
    ('week', to_char(date_trunc('week', created_at), 'MM-DD'))
  ) d(dim, bucket)
)
select dim, bucket, count(*) n, sum(case when filled then 1 else 0 end) nf,
       round((avg(c) filter (where filled))::numeric, 2) fill_c,
       round((avg(c) filter (where not filled))::numeric, 2) unfill_c,
       round((avg(case when c < 0 then 1.0 else 0.0 end) filter (where filled))::numeric, 3) fill_loss,
       round((avg(case when c < 0 then 1.0 else 0.0 end) filter (where not filled))::numeric, 3) unfill_loss
from y group by dim, bucket having count(*) >= 12 order by dim, bucket
